feed.title: Decentralized Coinbase Payout Protocols (DCPP): A Framework for Discussion

entry.title: Decentralized Coinbase Payout Protocols (DCPP): A Framework for Discussion
entry.summary:
Exploring the integration of covenants significantly alters the possibilities for constructing outputs that can board any number of VTXOs into an Ark, providing a deterministic approach to transaction assembly. The introduction of covenants enables more sophisticated mechanisms within mining pool payout schemes, such as those found in p2pool. Here, flexibility is achieved by supporting multiple payout types, including both direct coinbase payouts and Ark payouts. An Ark payout address is structured to be generic across various Ark servers, containing both the server's public key and the user's VTXO public key. As a result, users with Ark payout addresses tied to the same server are aggregated into a single slot, thereby enhancing their ranking position during payout calculations.
Deterministic calculation becomes feasible for the Ark transaction tree, which facilitates payments to all miners involved and allows for a coinbase output that commits directly to this structure. This creates new opportunities for optimizing miner incentives and the distribution of block rewards. A proposed model involves allocating direct payouts to the top-value slots—such as awarding the nine highest payouts directly in a ten-slot system—while remaining miners participate in a value-weighted random draw for the residual reward. This mechanism aims to balance fairness and efficiency but may inadvertently encourage strategic behavior, where participants might avoid moving up to the direct payout tier to maintain favorable odds in the random draw. To counteract this, direct payouts could be adjusted to provide a small percentage more than each recipient's actual share, reducing the incentive to game the system by splitting identities or manipulating reward allocations.
Further refinement could involve rounding down direct payout amounts, which would simplify the process and incentivize miners to consistently use the same payout address. These adjustments collectively streamline the payout logic, discourage exploitative strategies, and strengthen the overall integrity and predictability of the mining pool's distribution mechanism.
